'''Menoda''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A famous bioanalyst, he vowed to destroy his life's work to protest the ongoing conflict and destroyed his own [[Menoda's laboratory|lab]], though not before he was convinced to share some of his more valuable research.
